setting.general.language.label: Interface language
setting.general.language.help: Language of the menus and windows. Automatic uses the language of the system.
setting.general.start_listening.label: Listen on start
setting.general.start_listening.help: Respond to the hotkey as soon as the app starts. If off, the app starts paused (unpause it from the tray menu).
setting.general.show_status_window.label: Status window
setting.general.show_status_window.help: Show a small window at the bottom of the screen while recording and transcribing. The tray icon changes colour anyway.
setting.general.log_to_console.label: Log to the console
setting.general.log_to_console.help: Print what the app is doing in the terminal (useful to diagnose problems).
setting.recording.hotkey.label: Hotkey
setting.recording.hotkey.help: Key or combination that starts and stops dictation, with keys joined by +. Examples: f8, ctrl+shift+space, alt+d.
setting.recording.swallow_hotkey.label: Keep the key to itself
setting.recording.swallow_hotkey.help: The hotkey does not reach the program you are typing in (no stray F8, no flickering while it is held or auto-repeated). Only for a single ordinary key like f8; key combinations and Ctrl/Alt/Shift/Win always pass through.
setting.recording.mode.label: Mode
setting.recording.mode.help: Press to start and press again to stop; hold the key while speaking; or stop by itself after a pause in your speech.
setting.recording.input_device_name.help: Microphone to record from, by name (or the start of the name). It keeps working when the system renumbers the devices. Empty = the default microphone.
setting.recording.input_device_index.hel: Alternative to the name: device number from 'python -m dictator --list-devices'. Only used if the name is empty or not found.
setting.recording.sample_rate.label: Sample rate (Hz)
setting.recording.sample_rate.help: Use the native rate of your microphone if you know it (often 48000). 16000 is enough for speech.
setting.recording.lead_in_ms.label: Trim start (ms)
setting.recording.lead_in_ms.help: Audio discarded at the start of every recording: the key click and any sound from the speakers before they are muted.
setting.recording.trailing_ms.label: Extra time at the end (ms)
setting.recording.trailing_ms.help: Keep recording a little after you stop, so the last syllable is not cut off.
setting.recording.silence_ms.label: Pause that ends it (ms)
setting.recording.silence_ms.help: Only in the voice-activity mode: silence after which the recording stops by itself.
setting.recording.no_voice_stop_s.label: Stop if nobody speaks (s)
setting.recording.no_voice_stop_s.help: If no voice is heard for this long (at the start or after you finish speaking), the recording stops by itself and the audio comes back. What you said is still transcribed. 0 = never.
setting.recording.min_duration_ms.label: Minimum length (ms)
setting.recording.min_duration_ms.help: Shorter recordings are discarded without transcribing them.
setting.transcription.backend.label: Engine
setting.transcription.backend.help: Local: a Whisper model on this computer (private, free; downloaded the first time). API: an OpenAI-compatible server (OpenAI or your own).
setting.transcription.language.label: Spoken language
setting.transcription.language.help: Language code of what you say (en, es, fr…). Empty = detect it automatically (slightly slower and less reliable).
setting.transcription.initial_prompt.hel: Optional text that guides the transcription: names, jargon, writing style. Whisper only reads its last ~224 tokens.
setting.transcription.temperature.label: Temperature
setting.transcription.temperature.help: 0 gives the most literal and repeatable result. Higher values add randomness.
setting.transcription.local_model.label: Local model
setting.transcription.local_model.help: Bigger models are more accurate but slower and need more memory. '.en' models only understand English.
setting.transcription.local_device.label: Run on
setting.transcription.local_device.help: cuda = NVIDIA graphics card; cpu = processor; automatic picks the best available.
setting.transcription.local_compute_type: Default is usually right. int8 uses less memory; float16 is fast on graphics cards.
setting.transcription.local_vad_filter.h: Cut silent parts before transcribing (local engine only).
setting.transcription.api_base_url.label: Server URL
setting.transcription.api_base_url.help: Address of the OpenAI-compatible API, ending in /v1. Change it to use your own server.
setting.transcription.api_model.label: Server model
setting.transcription.api_model.help: Model name the server expects (whisper-1 for OpenAI; for your own server, the model it serves).
setting.transcription.api_key.label: API key
setting.transcription.api_key.help: Needed for OpenAI. Your own server usually ignores it. If empty, the OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable is used.
setting.output.method.label: How to write
setting.output.method.help: Paste: the whole text at once through the clipboard (your previous clipboard text is restored). Type: key by key.
setting.output.type_delay_ms.label: Delay between keys (ms)
setting.output.type_delay_ms.help: Only when typing key by key. Raise it if some program loses letters.
setting.output.add_trailing_space.label: Add a space at the end
setting.output.add_trailing_space.help: So the next dictation does not stick to this one.
setting.output.remove_trailing_period.he: Delete the full stop that Whisper usually adds at the end.
setting.output.lowercase.label: All lowercase
setting.output.lowercase.help: Convert the whole text to lowercase.
setting.output.dictionary_file.label: Corrections file
setting.output.dictionary_file.help: Text file with one 'wrong=right' per line to fix words that are often misheard (# = comment). Whole words, keeps capitals. Read again on every dictation.
setting.sounds.start_sound.label: Start sound
setting.sounds.start_sound.help: Plays before the microphone opens: it is the signal to start speaking.
setting.sounds.stop_sound.label: Stop sound
setting.sounds.stop_sound.help: Plays as soon as you stop, without waiting for the transcription.
setting.sounds.done_sound.label: Sound when the text is written
setting.sounds.done_sound.help: A soft note when the text has been pasted or typed.
setting.sounds.start_sound_file.label: Start sound file
setting.sounds.start_sound_file.help: Your own 16-bit WAV for the start. Empty = the built-in one.
setting.sounds.stop_sound_file.label: Stop sound file
setting.sounds.stop_sound_file.help: Your own 16-bit WAV for the stop. Empty = the built-in one.
setting.sounds.output_device_name.label: Speakers for the sounds
setting.sounds.output_device_name.help: Output device for the sounds, by name. Empty = the default output.
setting.ducking.enabled.label: Mute audio while dictating
setting.ducking.enabled.help: Silence the computer while you dictate so the microphone does not pick up music or videos, and restore it as soon as you stop. Programs' own volumes are never touched. If Dictator closes in the middle, it restores the audio on the next start.
setting.ducking.mute_system_output.label: Mute the system output
setting.ducking.mute_system_output.help: Mute the default output device (the Windows volume mute) while dictating.
For Voicemeeter users: strip numbers separated by commas (e.g. 5, 6, 7 for the virtual inputs of Voicemeeter Potato). They are unmuted as soon as you stop. Empty = do not touch Voicemeeter.
setting.ducking.voicemeeter_dll.label: Voicemeeter library
setting.ducking.max_duration_s.label: Safety limit (s)
setting.ducking.max_duration_s.help: If a recording lasts longer than this, the volume is restored anyway. 0 = no limit.
setting.clips.enabled.label: Save every dictation
setting.clips.enabled.help: Keep the audio (FLAC) and its text (.txt) of each dictation, for example to train a voice. Done in the background; it never slows down dictation.
setting.clips.folder.label: Folder
setting.clips.folder.help: Where the recordings are saved. Empty = a 'clips' folder next to the settings file.
setting.clips.min_duration_s.label: Minimum length (s)
setting.clips.upload_command.label: Command to send them
setting.clips.upload_command.help: Optional command run for each saved recording, with {audio} and {text} replaced by the files. Example: scp -q -B {audio} {text} user@server:/clips/ — if it succeeds the local files are deleted; if not, they are retried later.
